searchText: Hi everyone, This is Garvit from Electron Labs. I need some help from the community. We are doing some research on creating Eth2 light clients *that can cause validator slashing*. (The current Altair LC is not accountable - https://prestwich.substack.com/p/altair). We wanted someone with good knowledge of Eth2 consensus to have a look on our work and provide feedback. Anyone here who could help us? I’m happy to give it a look (I’m a Lighthouse dev), you can DM me. <@881905303011086387> has also written a draft spec to make sync committee messages slashable and would be the most qualified in this area Thanks a ton. DM'ed you 🙂 "draft spec" is not really a "spec" yet, but have drafted an approach that could work for sync committee slashing of most attack scenarios: https://github.com/etan-status/consensus-specs/commit/lc-slashing

excerpts.author: garvit_electron
excerpts.content:
Hi everyone,

This is Garvit from Electron Labs. I need some help from the community. We are doing some research on creating Eth2 light clients *that can cause validator slashing*. (The current Altair LC is not accountable - https://prestwich.substack.com/p/altair).

We wanted someone with good knowledge of Eth2 consensus to have a look on our work and provide feedback. Anyone here who could help us?

excerpts.author: sproul
excerpts.content:
I’m happy to give it a look (I’m a Lighthouse dev), you can DM me.

<@881905303011086387> has also written a draft spec to make sync committee messages slashable and would be the most qualified in this area

excerpts.author: etan_status
excerpts.content:
"draft spec" is not really a "spec" yet, but have drafted an approach that could work for sync committee slashing of most attack scenarios:
https://github.com/etan-status/consensus-specs/commit/lc-slashing
